The '''Roiya Rift''' was a rocky labyrinth located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The entrance to the Roiya Rift was marked by a semicircle of jagged rocks which gave the impression of [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. The rocky pillars continued throughout the rift, lining a series of twisting passageways that led further into the Jundland Wastes. The area was a favored hiding place for the native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].
